blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Gilas Pilipinas will take on Chinese Taipei in the women’s 5-on-5 basketball quarterfinals of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 on Thursday. The matchup was set after Gilas women ended the group stage as the fourth seeded team in the quarterfinals, followed by the Taiwanese at fifth. They clash on Thursday at 3 p.m. at Aichi International Arena, with Gilas seeking a first-ever trip to the semifinals and a chance to bring home a medal in the Asian Games.
